headline: AI-powered browsers challenge Chrome, Safari with new features
summary: Several startups and Big Tech firms are launching AI-powered browsers
details: The browser wars have entered a new phase, with AI-powered browsers emerging as alternatives to Chrome and Safari. Companies like Perplexity, The Browser Company, and Opera are launching browsers that leverage AI to perform tasks and provide personalized experiences.

Perplexity's Comet browser acts as a chatbot-based search engine, while The Browser Company's Dia offers an AI chat tool to help users navigate the web. Opera's Neon browser has contextual awareness and can perform tasks offline.

Other players in the space include OpenAI's Atlas browser, which allows users to ask ChatGPT about search results, and Jatter, an AI-powered browser that offers personalized recommendations and an integrated Notes app.
caption:
Can AI-powered browsers dethrone Chrome and Safari?

The browser wars have entered a new phase, with AI-powered browsers emerging as alternatives to Chrome and Safari. Companies like Perplexity, The Browser Company, and Opera are launching browsers that leverage AI to perform tasks and provide personalized experiences.

Perplexity's Comet browser acts as a chatbot-based search engine, while The Browser Company's Dia offers an AI chat tool to help users navigate the web. Opera's Neon browser has contextual awareness and can perform tasks offline.

Other players in the space include OpenAI's Atlas browser, which allows users to ask ChatGPT about search results, and Jatter, an AI-powered browser that offers personalized recommendations and an integrated Notes app.
